text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along the training course right after the rain cleared,
Epiphaneia sprinted with incredible spirit and momentum.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! More! Give me more!
Let me run even more!
choice_data_list: No, any more than this would really be...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Right now! I'm in top condition!
My whole body is overflowing with energy!
It'd be such a waste to stop!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I just want to run with someone!
With how I am right now, I know for sure I can be a big help!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The "Voice of Destiny" says so too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is she riding a high from completing such a hardcore routine?
I want to appreciate her motivation,
but honestly, worry outweighs it."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice, look at that power!
I'd love for you to run with me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Rickey!
Could it be, feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's been raining the past few days, right?
Because of that, a bit of negative energy
has gathered on the track.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yet today we finally have clear skies! Plus, a pleasant wind
is blowing from the southeast, raising the positive qi!
So—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see! So that's where I come in!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Exactly! First of all, Epi-san herself is like a bundle of positive energy, super spirited!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Epi-san, you have really loud footsteps, don't you?
Loud noises ward off evil spirits, so it kills two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Chimes or nature sounds are fine, but—
your footsteps would be way more effective, Epi-san!
So please, run with me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Rickey is more than a worthy opponent!
Put my spirit to full use!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both are fully motivated, but the atmosphere certainly doesn't feel like it will end with just light exercise.
choice_data_list: Since you're so motivated, why not give it a shot?
Since you're all fired up, let's give it a shot!
Isn't it overflowing a bit too much with cheerful energy this time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both are fully motivated, but the atmosphere certainly doesn't feel like it will end with just light exercise.
choice_data_list: Since you're so motivated, why not give it a shot?
Since you're all fired up, let's give it a shot!
Isn't it overflowing a bit too much with cheerful energy this time?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got Trainer's permission!
Let's go, Rickey! I've been itching to run this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A full sprint right off the bat!?
Then I'm going all out too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it was the influence of how the two ran, but the track seemed to shine brighter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmm, now that you mention it, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You can't do this to me, Rickey!
Not after getting me all fired up like this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry.
Though just as Trainer says, your yang energy might be running a little too strong right now, Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Shall we chat
and cool down together today?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Can't be helped then!
If you ever need anything else, I'll be glad to help!"
